findings_resolved: Async delegate preparation is const-correct without inferring authority or backend effects.
async_result<async_error> distinguishes owned error-valued results from tagged failures.
FF then/on_error/end preserve invocation of mutable stateful callables; a standalone regression also covers reference capture.
The FF CUDA adapter is compiled as host C++; only native device operations go through NVCC. FF raw storage was not changed.
CUDA demo targets respect the configured architecture rather than hardcoding sm_52.

cases_per_variant: normal scalar/image completion and continuation close/release
event-record failure after launch, plus continuation close/release

ci: FF CPU demo coverage and pinned CUDA compile container configured; hosted GPU tests explicitly skip without a device.
performance: No new throughput claim. Prior measurement sources and numbers are preserved.
